fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 1st Semester (Autumn): Classes begin Sep 7, 2026 (Welcome Week Sep 7-10, 2026); ~19-20 weeks running through Jan/Feb.

spring_term_dates.value: 2nd Semester (Spring): Runs mid-February through June/July (~19 weeks).

tuition_model.notes: 2020-2021 fact sheet states no tuition fee for mobility students.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory student accident/health insurance required upon registration (no tuition fee for mobility students).

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/The Polytechnic Institute of Braganca/The Polytechnic Institute of Braganca.docx
housing_availability.notes: 2020-2021 fact sheet noted SAS residences were reserved for Portuguese scholarship students while IRO + ESN Bragança helped find private rooms; current ipb.pt indicates IRO assists international/mobility students with student residences (subject to availability) or private flats.

housing_notes.value: IRO and ESN assist incoming exchange students with housing (student residences subject to availability or shared private rooms; 2020-2021 fact sheet listed private rooms at €120-€140/month).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/The Polytechnic Institute of Braganca/The Polytechnic Institute of Braganca.docx

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students must obtain a Portuguese Study Visa from the Portuguese Embassy/Consulate before arrival using IPB's acceptance letter, proof of financial means, valid health insurance, and accommodation details. Lead time not specified.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system (1 ECTS = 27 hours workload per ipb.pt): standard full-time load is 30 ECTS per semester (60 ECTS/year).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/The Polytechnic Institute of Braganca/The Polytechnic Institute of Braganca.docx

campus_type.notes: Campuses in Bragança and Mirandela (EsACT), plus Chaves (per ipb.pt).

international_support_services.value: Erasmus Opening Session, Welcome Week & Mentoring Academy, ESN Bragança buddy/housing support, and intensive/semester Portuguese language course (3 ECTS).
